question: Who was famous for inventing the power battery, one of the first devices to provide a reliable source of electricity, in 1800?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alessandro Volta

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Alessandro Volta was an Italian physicist, chemist, and lay Catholic who was a pioneer of electricity and power and is credited as the inventor of the electric battery and the discoverer of methane.
 
• He was an Italian physicist whose invention of the electric battery provided the first source of continuous current.
